title: Tamsin and the Winter
author: Casper Sandoval
blurb: Coral Blackwood, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
